card.name: Daily after number of times
card.fires_on: The word daily (or day) closing a dose frequency such as three times, twice, or 6 times per, in dosage instructions for eye drops and topical products.

modes.label: Times daily
modes.description: Daily completes a count of times in a dosing instruction.
modes.example: The recommended dose is one drop of SIMBRINZA in the affected eye(s) three times<< daily>>.

modes.label: Per day or a day
modes.description: Day ends a frequency phrase after per or a.
modes.example: One drop of OXERVATE in the affected eye(s), 6 times per<< day>> at 2-hour intervals

card.plain: It marks the word daily or day that finishes how many times a day a drug is used.
